text: EXAMPLE, not approved: The Kraansvlak herd is a herd of wisents (European bison).
EXAMPLE, not approved: Konik horses and Scottish Highland cattle also graze in Kraansvlak.
EXAMPLE, not approved: The herd lives in Nationaal Park Zuid-Kennemerland.
EXAMPLE, not approved: PWN manages the area.
EXAMPLE, not approved: The first three wisents were released in Kraansvlak in April 2007.
EXAMPLE, not approved: Keep at least 50 metres from the wisents and 25 metres from other large grazers.
EXAMPLE, not approved: Visitors may see the herd from the designated paths and from the lookout by the dune lake.
EXAMPLE, not approved: The yellow-marked Wisentenpad through the area is open from 1 September to 1 March and closed in the bird breeding season.
EXAMPLE, not approved: If the animals lie on the path or come towards you, turn back or walk round the herd in a wide arc. Never walk through the herd.
EXAMPLE, not approved: The wisents are not fed by people and find their own food in the dunes.
